Hi Ivy,

Congratulations again — we loved meeting you across the loop. Attached is the first-pass offer packet: Offer_Letter_IvyChen_v1.pdf. It reflects the compensation band for Senior ML Engineer, the standard 12-month restricted stock schedule, and a $20,000 sign-on that we discussed.

Thanks for the context, Sean. I reviewed the packet and Ivy's notes. Short answers below and next steps: 

1) Sign-on exception: Approvable with justification. We require the Compensation Policy Deviation Form completed (attached) and manager sign-off. Given the candidate's counteroffer and the role's criticality, I am comfortable approving a $20k exception for this req. Please complete the deviation form and include market comps (we can reference the benchmark doc). 

2) Start date: We can accommodate a start of Oct 4. If there's any pro-ration on the sign-on we should state it explicitly: 
   - Option A (preferred): Full sign-on payable at start if start <= Oct 10.
   - Option B: If start > Oct 10, sign-on reduced by 50% at start, remaining 50% paid at 6 months.

3) Offer clauses / redlines: Legal suggests tightening the "at-will" paragraph and clarifying the stock grant vesting cliff language so it is unambiguous for cross-border tax treatment. I attached a redline of the template with those edits and a blank deviation form.

Next steps for you:
- Fill the Compensation_Policy_Deviation_Form.docx with the rationale and attach market comps (1–2 lines).
- Confirm which start date option you want to present (A or B).
- I’ll route the deviation and redlined offer to People Ops and Legal for signatures.

Please attach the filled deviation form to the HR system and cc me. I can sign before Legal as long as the form has manager justification.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP People Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Hi Ivy,

Thanks for the quick turn. Per our internal approvals (Laura signed off on the exception), attached is a revised offer: Offer_Letter_IvyChen_v3.pdf. Highlights of the revisions: 

- Sign-on: $20,000 (approved via comp deviation). Payment terms: Option A (for clarity we will present Option A in the DocuSign envelope): Full sign-on payable at start if start <= Oct 10. If for any reason you require a later start beyond Oct 10, we will switch to the Option B schedule (50% at start, 50% at 6 months).
- Start date: We have included Oct 4 as your proposed start; the offer text also notes "start window Oct 4–8, 2026" to accommodate your commitment.
- Legal redlines: tightened "at-will" language and clarified RSU cliff / vesting to avoid ambiguity for tax treatment.

Next steps to finalize: 
1) Review Offer_Letter_IvyChen_v3.pdf.
2) If it looks good, I will send the DocuSign envelope tonight (est. 2–3 business hours for signatures) and route the deviation form to People Ops with Laura's approval.
3) Once signed, People Ops will confirm onboarding details and your cohort assignment.

If you want the sign-on split alternative (Option B) instead of Option A, reply and I will update the envelope.

DocuSign link (will be included in the envelope): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-ivy
